notes: stoned him with stones: 'even is an adverbial accusative of instrument with no preposition, so the supplied with joins the noun under rule 33, while the later ba-'esh and ba-'avanim have their own prepositions.
The preposition of ba-yyom ha-zzeh is unrepresented, the ASV writing this day bare (rule 40), and both articles yield to the demonstrative (rules 41, 47).
